thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated request queueing and 5xx spike detected across inference pool eu-west & apac at 2187654321. Impact: increased tail latency for 'chat' and 'embed' endpoints. Auto-throttle attempted but ineffective. Paging SRE oncall.
Maya Patel: I'm on it, pinging oncall now. Can someone post the initial customer impact numbers?
Alex Chen: Seeing 3x error rate for embeddings in eu-west, latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.4s. APAC has similar pattern but lower 5xx. Economy lane QPS doubled in last 10m.
Ryan Gomez: Looks like a few noisy keys from a churny customer are saturating small-model slots. Per-key top offenders: key=acct_9831 (~18k req/min), acct_473 (~9k).
Cheng Li: Repro: small-quantized variant sometimes triggers high CPU on host when KV cache thrash occurs. Suspect cache invalidation storm when sequence lengths vary.
Priya Rao: Paging note: impact to some paying customers in EU/EU-S high. Customer-ops starting outreach for those with SLA.
Maya Patel: Plan: 1) apply regional backpressure via smart-routing weights (drop economy lane weight in eu-west by 60%), 2) add per-key soft rate limit for top noisy keys, 3) route new requests from APAC -> us-west latency tier for best-effort, 4) temporary disable quantized-small model variant in eu-west.
Alex Chen: I'm ready to apply traffic policy. Patch snippet I'm going to push to routing controller:
```
{
  "region_overrides": {
    "eu-west": {
      "lanes": { "economy": { "weight": 0.4 }, "standard": { "weight": 0.5 }, "latency": { "weight": 0.1 } },
      "model_variants_blocklist": ["small-quant-q4_0"]
    },
    "apac": {
      "lanes": { "economy": { "weight": 0.6 }, "standard": { "weight": 0.3 }, "latency": { "weight": 0.1 } },
      "steer_to": "us-west-latency"
    }
  },
  "per_key_limits": [{ "key": "acct_9831", "qps": 3000 }, { "key": "acct_473", "qps": 1500 }]
}
```
OpsBot: Applying policy to routing-controller v2.0 (dry-run -> commit).
OpsBot: commit successful, propagation to edge proxies started (~30s).
Maya Patel: Confirmed: edge proxies in eu-west received new weights, economy lane traffic reduced.
Alex Chen: Disabling small-quantized variant in eu-west runtime pools now: `redwood ctl variant disable small-quant-q4_0 --region eu-west --reason "latency spike mitigation"`
Cheng Li: Variant disable propagated. Observability: p95 for embeds down 40% in eu-west already. 5xx trending down but still above baseline.
Ryan Gomez: Implemented per-key soft caps via ratelimiter patch. Keys acct_9831 and acct_473 now limited at 3k/1.5k qps with 10s leaky-bucket.
Priya Rao: Customer-ops: notified two Tier 1 customers in EU (email + phone). One acknowledges they're running a bulk migration, asked for temporary adjustment window.
Maya Patel: Good. Next: monitor for 10m, if stable we keep economy weight reduced and schedule canary rollback of variant in 2h. If not stable, escalate to capacity burst allocation for latency tier.
Alex Chen: Quick note: non-eu regions unaffected by variant change; we intentionally targeted eu-west only. APAC steering to us-west should smooth latency but increases cross-region egress. Finance aware.
IncidentBot: NOTE: PagerDuty escalation to SRE Lead at 2187654350 (manual).
Cheng Li: Observability update @2187654375: eu-west embed 5xx back to 0.8x baseline, p95 now 220ms. APAC steer showing slight p50 increase in us-west but within SLO.
Ryan Gomez: I'm keeping close eye on cache evictions; eviction rate normalized after cap + variant disable.
Maya Patel: Handoff: I'm going to step out for a short break, handing oncall to Alex for next 30m. Alex, please keep the mitigation in place and coordinate with customer-ops for any SLA impacts.
Alex Chen: Taking over. Will keep channel updated every 5–10m. If we need more headroom, request Dedicated burst to latency tier or temporary model downscaling.
Priya Rao: Customer-ops will follow up with affected customers with an ETA for full resolution. Logging notes/exec summary saved to runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/2187654321
OpsBot: Monitoring rule: create alert if p95 > 500ms in eu-west for next 60m -> notify #eng-sre and escalate to SRE Lead.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — great quick moves. Leave mitigation active until we confirm 30m stable, then gradual restore.
Alex Chen: 10m update: all critical indicators improving. Keeping per-key caps for another 20m, then will ramp economy weight + re-enable small variant in canary if healthy.
IncidentBot: Incident annotated: mitigation applied (regional backpressure, per-key caps, variant disable). Root cause investigation ticket created: INC-218765-rca.
Maya Patel: Closing action items: RCA owner assigned (Cheng), follow-up meeting scheduled in 24h, and add a guard in model onboarding to simulate cache-thrash scenarios.
Cheng Li: Acknowledged. Will start triage and post initial findings to the RCA ticket.
Alex Chen: Handoff complete. Leaving channel open for async updates. :thumbsup:
